About **56% of Italians** said it was very important for the media to report news without government or state censorship, according to [Pew Research Center’s 2019 survey](https://www.pewresearch.org/global/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2019/10/Pew-Research-Center-Value-of-Europe-report-FINAL-UPDATED.pdf).

CONFIDENCE: 99
